chunks: And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: “Shall I not inform you of the worst of your women?”
They said: “Yes, O Messenger of Allah, then inform us.”

He said: “Among the worst of your women is the one who is lowly among her family, mighty with her husband, barren, rancorous, who does not refrain from anything vile, who displays herself when her husband is absent, but is chaste with him when he is present; the one who does not listen to his speech nor obey his command; and when he is alone with her, she resists with the resistance of a difficult mount when it is ridden; she does not accept any excuse from him, nor forgive any fault of his.”

key_terms.الذَّلِيلَةُ: one who is lowly or abased in her own family setting
key_terms.الْمُتَبَرِّجَةُ: one who displays her adornment openly

ai.seo_question: What traits does the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله describe as the worst qualities in women?
ai.summary: This hadith describes blameworthy traits in a wife within the marital relationship and warns against patterns of resentment, immodesty, defiance, and refusal of reconciliation. It serves as an ethical teaching on destructive spousal conduct and the importance of proper character in family life.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4376 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Shall I not inform you about the worst of your women?"
They said: "Yes, O Messenger of Allah (swt), tell us."
He said: "The worst of your women is the one who is humble and submissive with her family but domineering and arrogant with her husband. She is barren, spiteful, and does not refrain from committing indecency. She flaunts herself when her husband is absent but is reserved and guarded when he is present. She does not listen to his words nor obey his commands. When he is alone with her, she behaves stubbornly like a difficult mount that resists being ridden. She neither accepts his apology nor forgives his faults."
